Only 23% of remote jobs list pay. Here's what that means for your job search.

We analyzed 4,441 active remote listings on Loker Dollar. Only 1,000 (23%) include a salary figure. The other 3,441 (77%) keep pay private. But that doesn't mean low wages—many expect negotiation.

More highlights:
- 2,753 listings (62%) are open to worldwide applicants.
- Communication is the top skill (39% of listings), AI is growing (12%).
- 1,427 engineering roles are open, with 276 posted this week.

Neo Financial is the only company in our spotlight with disclosed pay: $5/hour for bilingual client services. TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether are hiring but don't show rates.

Ready to explore? Browse the live board and filter for "worldwide remote" to see 2,753 roles open to you.

https://lokerdollar.com/en
